Like a dense fog unseen by the eyes, yet felt upon the skin.

Time feels as though it is holding its breath.
Shadows appear deeper than they should be.
This aura does not shout.

Its gaze is calm, yet it seems to hold thousands of untold secrets.
Its steps are slow, yet they feel weighted—each one carrying stories never spoken.
Not evil.
Not frightening.

Its gaze is clear, carrying a sense of safety that is hard to explain.
Its smile is small, yet enough to ignite hope in others’ hearts.
Not loud.
Not forceful.
